summary: Queries the network system pointer stored at this+0x1B79C and, only when it is non-null and sub_563E70 reports the network/system as capable, sets a flag on that network system pointer. Returns the flag result in that branch, otherwise the unchanged early result (the this-pointer value).

operations.description: Guard on the network system pointer at this + 0x1B79C being non-null; if null, skip the dispatch body.
sub_563E70() queries whether the network/system is capable of initialization.
Guard on the capability result being non-zero; proceed to flag-setting only when capable.
Set the flag on the network system pointer (SetFlagIfPointerNonNull on this+0x1B79C) and return its result.
Fall-through return of the early result when either guard fails.
